name: SpecGen Hash
description: Auto-generated constants for SPECGEN.md integrity verification. Exports SPECGEN_HASH (SHA-256 of the workspace SPECGEN.md seeded with app version) and SPECGEN_VERSION (current app version stamped at build time). Regenerated on every build via build-renderer.js. Imported by SpecsMapPlugin for integrity badge display.

constants.name: SPECGEN_HASH
constants.description: SHA-256 hex digest of workspace SPECGEN.md content seeded with app version

constants.name: SPECGEN_VERSION
constants.description: Version string stamped at build time (e.g. '0.0.20260602')
